statement: Pinned libogc WPAD encodes signed PCM input as 4-bit Yamaha ADPCM, high nibble first, and streams report 0x18 with a five-bit length shifted into the control byte, at most 20 encoded bytes. Its periodic alarm is configured for 6,666,667 ns and sends 20-byte blocks; the speaker initialization selects ADPCM format 0x00 rather than emitting 8-bit PCM format 0x40. This is a source scheduler request, not a measured radio cadence or decoder sample rate; the callback sends fixed 20-byte blocks even when the remaining buffer is shorter.
